description.value: Hermann's Jazz Club is Canada's longest continuously running jazz club, tracing its roots to 1981 and now a civic institution in the heart of downtown Victoria. Operated by the non-profit Arts on View Society with the City of Victoria as building owner since 2024, it offers an intimate 130-seat lounge and restaurant featuring nightly live jazz, blues, and world music alongside a full dinner menu. A touring cyclist finishing a day's ride will find a convivial evening venue with hearty entrées and a rich local music culture steps from the city centre.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 73m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m. Total: 8 spaces.
